text:
Maya: heads-up — CuroHealth onboarding stuck at payment attach. Their billing webhook POSTs are getting 403 signature errors. Ticket SUP-9988 created. Customer has renewal call in 3 days, marking P0 for CS.
Luis: yikes. Can you paste the webhook raw and error? Ill prep proactive comms if this looks like renewal-risk.
Maya: raw request header snippet:
```
POST /hooks/billing HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.example
X-Signature: sha256=abc123def
Status: 403

{"error":"signature_mismatch","received_sig":"sha256=abc123def","expected_sig":"sha256=zzxy987"}
```
Maya: They send from their payment provider via our passthrough. Happening for 4 invoices across 2 admins.
Rina: likely our new strict-signature check (deployed yesterday) is rejecting older provider payloads that use timestamp skew. Do we have their provider whitelisted?
Maya: support notes say provider=PayNow (v2) and integration was set up last month.
Rina: quick mitigation: enable relaxed webhook validation for tenant=curohealth for 48h (accept ±5m skew) and add audit log. I can flip the flag now.
WebhookBot: feature.toggle.relaxed_webhook_validation set=true for tenant=curohealth (by Rina)
Rina: done. Maya - can you ask CuroHealth to retry and confirm?
Maya: CuroHealth retried, now payments attached successfully. Theyre unblocked :white_check_mark:
Luis: OK good. Drafting customer message: short apology, what we did to unblock, timeline for permanent fix, offer 30-min call and a one-time pro-rated month credit. Posting draft below for review. Keep wording non-technical about flags.
Luis: "Hi Sara — sorry for the interruption. Weve applied a temporary change on our side to allow your billing to complete while we roll a permanent fix. Our engineers will deploy a patch by EOD tomorrow and well confirm once its live. Wed also like to offer a one-time pro-rated month credit for the inconvenience and can schedule a 30-minute walkthrough if helpful. — Luis, Customer Success"
Jon: finance ok with pro-rated credit. Please put exact amount when sending.
Rina: schedule: push permanent fix that widens accepted timestamp window + add a compatibility test for PayNow v2. ETA 2026-03-24 09:30 PT. Ill own release and rollback plan.
Luis: Ill send the customer message after removing internal flag names. Maya please add SUP-9988 link to the calendar invite for the walkthrough.
Maya: invite sent to Sara + eng contact, SUP-9988 link added.
Luis: customer replied: "Thanks — can finish billing now. Please confirm when fix is live, and well join the walkthrough tomorrow."
Rina: will deploy tomorrow morning and post release note. After deploy, Ill flip relaxed_webhook_validation=false and notify CS.
Jon: note renewal risk as "elevated" until post-deploy confirmation. Account owner looped in.
Maya: closing support ticket as workaround validated. Marking account health: at-elevated-risk -> improving.
Luis: tracking items: 1) Deploy permanent fix (Rina) ETA 2026-03-24 09:30 PT, 2) Rollback temp relax flag after verification (Rina), 3) Post-deploy customer follow-up (Luis), 4) Walkthrough session (Maya).
Luis: thanks team :pray: well follow up in the post-mortem channel with root cause and test added to CI.
